summary: Madison Butte: 1923 cupola house replaced by a 37-ft steel tower in 1957; Forest Service still staffs it each summer; hike-in trail with no fee.

facts.design: 13x13 Plan CL-100 cab on a 37-ft K-brace steel tower; replaced a 1923 D-6 cupola ground cab
facts.agency: US Forest Service, Umatilla National Forest (Heppner Ranger District)

access.note: Staffed each summer. The hiking trail is open with no fee and a rough road to the top was gated in late May 2024. The sources read do not say whether the cab is open to visitors.

visit.trail_note: Madison Butte Trail #3054 starts just past the Tupper Work Center off FS Road 21 and ends 1 mile west of the lookout on FS Road 2119-033. No fee. Heppner Ranger District (541) 676-9187.

events.note: Milt Spurlock recorded as lookout the year a new telephone line was constructed; earliest named lookout in the sources read

37-ft steel tower with a CL-100 cab replaced the 1923 D-6 cupola

Umatilla National Forest file, quoted on Forest Lookouts: the new tower and house were used for the first time this year

corrections.proposed: 13x13 Plan CL-100 cab on a 37-ft K-brace steel tower; D-6 was the 1923 cupola it replaced
corrections.why: The record's D-6 describes the 1923 cupola. NHLR and firelookout.com describe the present 37-ft tower with a CL-100 cab, dated 1957.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 5,642 ft (1,720 m); a May 2024 visit page gives 5,707 ft. The record keeps the NHLR figure (1719.7 m).

NHLR and Forest Lookouts date the present tower to 1957, with first use in 1958 per Forest Lookouts. A 1969 USGS recovery note describes an earlier tower torn down about 15 years before and a newer one rebuilt nearby; the sources read do not say whether that note describes the 1957 tower. NHLR calls the 1923 cab a ground cab.

notes_for_editor: Brief's NHLR registration date (July 4, 2022) was not in the NHLR text I read, so no nhlr_registered event is recorded; the NHLR page was read only for location, elevation, build and design. Registry numbers US 1632 / OR 150 and the Standing status appear on the Forest Fire Lookout Association standing list (read during the McGraw task; not cited as evidence here). Firelookout.com's staffing line is undated; as_of 2024 comes from the May 2024 visit page. Search snippets mentioned a 2024 trailhead closure and a 2023 staffed trip report; neither was read, so neither is in the story. A 1981 helicopter accident at the lookout site (quoted on the Forest Lookouts page) is omitted for length. Access is marked restricted because the cab's status for visitors is not stated in any source read; no climb is encouraged. Reads: 5 pages plus one re-read of the Forest Lookouts page; 2 web searches.
